title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Elena Morales
description: Motivation: provide opinionated RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to lower onboarding time for engineers integrating agents and external tools. This PR adds a set of reusable agent templates (finder, summarizer, multi-tool orchestrator), multiple tool-calling examples (calendar, search, vector-db lookup), and updates the docs site navigation and quickstart pages. Changes span redwood (docs site), redwood-examples (agent templates + sample apps), and minor README/quickstart snippets in redwood-sdk-python. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and example agents - [x] Add tool-calling quickstarts and sample tool implementations - [x] Docs site updates: new quickstarts page, sidebar entry, and code samples - [x] Add tests for example agent harness (smoke) - [x] Run docs CI and verify builds Locally verified: examples run with toy vector DB (memory store) and example tools; docs build passes with mkdocs. Notes: kept templates intentionally minimal but documented required environment variables and KMS placeholder for secrets. Migration: none; this is additive. See linked linear items for roadmap context.

release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts: new examples and docs to accelerate agent integrations. No breaking changes.
notes_for_maintainers: This PR touches examples and docs only. When backporting doc changes to the release branch, ensure mkdocs.yml sidebar entries align with versioned docs. Example templates reference a simple in-memory vector store by default; customers should replace with production vector DB and provide KMS-managed secrets for tool credentials.
testing_summary: Added a lightweight smoke harness under redwood-examples/tests/smoke that starts an example agent with a memory vector store and two stub tools. CI runs the smoke harness; first CI run showed timing flakiness and was addressed by adjusting the harness timeouts and adding a retry in tool-calling code. All CI checks green on final run.
user_impact: Developers will be able to use the new templates in redwood-examples to quickly prototype RAG + agent flows and follow the docs quickstarts for tool-calling integration. No API changes to hosted endpoints.
